title: Specialized Architecture, MEP, Mechanical & Raster toolsets
objective: Add a bounded set of specialized professional toolsets on top of the verified CAD/BIM core without changing ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1 or CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0: architecture (profile/wall, door/window, roof, stair, railing, rooms/spaces, dimensioning and component placement/editing composed over verified BIM primitives), MEP (bounded duct/pipe/conduit routing with connectors/endpoints, deterministic route validation and clash/clearance diagnostics), mechanical (bounded machine/equipment layout with connector/port metadata and deterministic arrays/patterns) and raster/underlay (canonical raster reference records with identity, transform, clipping, visibility and persistence, deterministic stale/missing-reference behavior, and typed non-authoritative trace/vectorization) — exposed through versioned typed App API additions and one shared command registry with professional properties/context UI, while preserving the canonical Construction Graph/CADDocument model, engine isolation, Web/Electron semantic parity and deterministic evidence discipline.
acceptance_criteria: Representative architecture, MEP, mechanical and raster workflows execute through the governed App API with deterministic results.
Specialized records persist through save/open and replay with exact canonical identities and lineage.
Document-owned monotonic canonical identities for newly persisted specialized records.
One atomic revision per mutating command with exact undo/redo/replay.
Repeated execution over identical canonical inputs yields byte-identical declared semantic outputs and artifacts.
Web/Electron execute the same semantic stream and produce equivalent persisted results.
Existing pinned fixtures remain unchanged wherever the new fields are additive/optional.
Unsupported specialized capabilities return typed deterministic failures; no fabricated geometry or semantics.
Web/Electron semantic streams and pinned specialized fixture outputs match.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..017 plus compatibility/BIM/IFC baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Native engine operations remain behind the established adapter/worker boundaries.
Specialized UI workflows are exercised in real browser/Electron evidence, not API-only mocks.
Exact final implementation head is CI-verified and deployed/browser-verified where applicable.
Interoperability preserves IFC/BCF/IDS compatibility for supported specialized properties and references and emits explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes otherwise.
Governance evidence binds implementation, CI, deployment, merge and post-merge verification to exact revisions and timestamps.
No protected architecture artifact changes; any required architecture change follows the ACR/version path.
non_goals: General-purpose mechanical feature/history modeling or a general-purpose mechanical kernel.
Full raster-to-vector reconstruction or unrestricted OCR-driven authoring.
Unbounded third-party plugin execution (the P017 boundary remains authoritative).
Replacing the App API, Construction Graph, CADDocument, renderer or engine-adapter boundaries.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-017 is VERIFIED and is the required predecessor baseline before P018 implementation.
Construction Graph remains authoritative and CADDocument remains the editor representation.
ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1 and CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 remain frozen throughout P018.
Existing engine, worker, persistence, automation, command and documentation boundaries remain available and authoritative as defined by prior verified work.
evidence_requirements: Architecture toolset workflow tests (profile/wall, door/window, roof, stair, railing, rooms/spaces, dimensioning, component placement/editing).
MEP routing/connector tests with deterministic route validation and clash/clearance diagnostics.
Mechanical layout, equipment/port-metadata and deterministic array/pattern tests.
Raster/underlay tests covering reference identity, transform, clipping, visibility, persistence, stale/missing-reference behavior and the typed non-authoritative trace result.
Canonical persistence, identity and lineage tests (save/open/replay with exact canonical identities).
Deterministic replay and byte-identical pinned-fixture assertions.
Typed unsupported-outcome tests for specialized capabilities outside the bounded model.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..017 and compatibility baselines remain green and byte-identical.
Real browser and Electron UI evidence for the specialized workflows.
Exact-head deployment and browser verification where applicable.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.
